title: The True Spear Hero and His Companions
text: “So, Motoyasu, since you’re here, I guess it means it’s finally time for that ‘partner swap’ thing… but looks like it’s still not going to happen.”
My Father looks at White Swan and Kou. “These are my partners! There are even some Filolial-sama who haven’t hatched yet.”
“Oh? Hasn’t it happened yet?”

In the first world, the companion swap took place the very day we arrived on the island. Since the goal was to interact for as short a time as possible, my Father’s companions were swapped with mine. Crimson Swine caused a commotion, and Lazy Pig passed information about Father to me—all without Crimson Swine finding out.
And I remember totally failing when I tried to seduce my Big Sister. When I went to see her, she was doing strength training. She gave the impression of taking the waves very seriously.
“Ah, it seems Ren and Itsuki went through theirs.”
Hmm… so Ren and Itsuki went first, then.
“Well, since Black Thunder and Fleon were your allies, the interaction itself was uneventful… though it seems it ended in a way that’s hard to call ‘uneventful.’”

Apparently, Ren’s original crew… even though they’re pretty much on the sidelines, they’re still around. They’re definitely there. I hear those guys took turns with Fleon and the Stalker Pig to visit Itsuki. The interaction went off without any major issues and ended on a smooth note. Indeed, with Ren’s crew and the Stalker Pig, it would be harder for them to cause trouble than not.
“When I got back to the inn that night, Fleon and Itsuki were doing some mysterious Super Sentai pose training, and they asked me for help—it was a real hassle.”
Sounds like there was quite a fun exchange going on. I wish I could’ve joined in. Next time, I’ll show off my Drive Mode. I’m sure Ren and Itsuki would let me join the group by now.
“Wait… I thought you were going to bring back some new girls, but instead you brought a Filolial.”
“Of course I did!”
“Gua!”
Yuki-chan takes a step forward and lets out a cry.
“This one is White Swan! And this one here is Kou!”
“Peep! Peep-peep!”
When held out, Kou started chirping affectionately at Father. For some reason, Kou’s reaction is excellent. I think in the previous loop, she was scared of Father, though…
“Ah, I see.”
“First, I’ll raise these kids properly, and then I’ll start training Filolial-sama in earnest!”
“So you’re turning them into a unit… When should I do this ‘comrade exchange’ thing? Or rather, when will I end up entrusting Raphtalia and the others to you?”
“How about I take the Big Sisters with me ahead of schedule to level them up? I can do it while I’m training the White Swans!”

I can show them just how strong I am, and I can give the Big Sisters some lessons, too. When it comes to combat, there’s plenty I can explain. I’ve got plenty of time right now to work out battle strategies that incorporate the White Swans into our combos. It’s time to plan things out with the Big Sisters!
“N-Naofumi-sama, are you really going to do this? If possible, I’d rather pass…”
“Oh my—”
“Hmm…?”
Eek… Am I supposed to be with Filo-tan and the others without my Father!? I’m not mentally prepared for that yet!
“W-well, the Big Sisters are fine, but I’d like to give Filo-tan some fun time with her Father.”
“Um… so, does that mean Filo just needs to stay with Master?”
“That’s right. While the Big Sisters are with me, I’d like Filo-tan to keep an eye on Father.”
“But—Master!　Filo gets to be with you, Master—all by herself, separate from the older sisters!”
Filo-tan looks absolutely thrilled! That makes me happy, too!
“……It’s all in how you phrase things. Well, with Filo here, I suppose we’ll be more than ready for the battle on Cal Mira Island……”
“Naofumi-sama…”
My Big Sister grabbed Father’s arm and looked at him with a pleading expression. Father let out a deep sigh, then turned to my Big Sisters and replied.
“For now, anyway. Given everything that’s happened, it seems Motoyasu doesn’t harbor any ill will toward me, right? It’s only for one day, so please bear with it. Besides, Sadeena’s here too.”
“Eww, even you’re scary, Big Sister!”
“Stop grinning and saying things you don’t even mean… Well then, I’m heading out with Filo, so Motoyasu, make sure you get along with Raphtalia and the others.”
“Of course! I’ll teach him with the utmost care and attention so he can live up to Father’s expectations.”
With that, I suddenly moved closer to Father and, just as I had when I seduced him back in Siltvelt, placed my hand under his chin.
“Guh!?”
“W-what are you doing!?”
I felt as if White Swan and Big Sister were both radiating a murderous aura, but before that could happen, Father flicked my hand away.
“…Motoyasu, what are you doing?”
“It’s a gesture of affection.”
Father made a really grim face. Then he took a few steps back and turned his back on me.
“Don’t do anything disgusting! Filo! Let’s go!”
“Okay!”
With that, my Father got into a small boat and set off.
“Na-Naofumi-samaaaaaaa!”
It was quite memorable how Big Sister tried to chase after Father’s retreating figure, but was stopped by her older sister and ended up just watching him go. Oh well, it’s just for today.
“Well then, I’ll drop off my luggage at the inn and head out hunting right away. Ah, it’s fine—I’ll be back at Father’s place by nightfall, so I’ll go without a care.”
“Raphtalia-chan, you’ll be able to get back to Naofumi-chan right away. Let’s do our best just like he said, okay?”
“…Yes.”
“Guaaaaah!”

It looked like White Swan was glaring at my Father, but and so, this is how we ended up hunting on Cal Mira Island. Since the Hermit must be exhausted, let’s have him rest at the inn. I’ve already asked him to enjoy the hot springs to his heart’s content. The most important thing is taking care of yourself after returning from a hunt. I plan to have the Hermit look into that for us.
“For now, it’s important to show the Big Sisters how we’re leveling up White Swan and the others while chatting with them about various things!”
After leaving our luggage—including Filolial-sama’s eggs—in our room at the inn, we set out hunting right away. Of course, we chose an island to avoid running into Father or Ren and the others.
“We’ll head deep into the island so as not to bother the other adventurers.”
“Yes.”

The Big Sisters are willing to come along as long as they fully understand the reason. Thanks to that, we were able to move swiftly to the remote interior where no other adventurers were present. However, one of the Big Sisters is constantly wary of me and won’t leave her older sister’s side.
“Well… what should we do, then? Personally, I’d like to prioritize leveling up White Swan and Kou, but if you want to work together to defeat the boss, I’ll make that a priority.”
“We’re currently in the middle of steadily leveling up thanks to Lord Naofumi’s talent enhancement, aren’t we?”
Come to think of it, we did come to Cal Mira Island without doing a Class Up this time. We had planned to leave the island temporarily to do a Class Up using the Dragon Hourglass.
“In that case, let’s do a Class Up on the Big Sisters while we’re doing a Class Up on White Swan and Kou. Then, after we go over our strategy thoroughly, shall we take down the boss?”
“……Understood.”
“Got it!”
“Gua!”
“Pii!”
The Big Sisters accepted my proposal, and we decided to head out hunting right away. First things first—leveling up! I’ll do my part, too!
“Aiming Lancer X! Brionac X! Gungnir X! Liberation Firestorm X! Liberation Prominence X! Hahaha! Weak! Way too weak, woooooooooo!”
We’re going to go on a rampage just a little ways before the boss area on Cal Mira Island!
“W-Wait, Spear Hero… please calm down! This is a massacre! It’s not a battle!”
“Guaaaaah!”
Big Sister tries to stop me, but White Swan keeps chasing after me, matching my movements. I’m kicking monsters left and right. I’m trying to improve my skills even just a little! I can’t lose here!
“Oh my… It’s quite a spectacular sight when it gets this intense.”
“Peep!”
Kou, perched on my Big Sister’s head and chirping energetically, is quite the sight.
“Liberation Fire Eye X!”
With a swift sweep of the Liberation Fire Eye, I’ll mow down those monsters.
“A, a beam of light from your eyes!?　Is the Spear Hero actually human!?”
“So you can do things like that with Magic, huh? Since you can use light magic too, Raphtalia-chan, why don’t you give it a try?”
“Sadeena-nee, please don’t joke around!”
“Do you want to learn it too, Big Sister? Well then, first we’ll need to build the spell based on your aptitude…”
“Please don’t try to teach me! I don’t want to learn it!”
Time for a short break until they respawn. I’ll boost the White Swans’ stats to match their new levels. Oh?
“Big Sister, I can’t enhance your stats unless you trust me…”
I tried to boost Big Sister’s stats, but it didn’t work.
“What would it take for you to believe that I trust you…?”
“But unless you trust me, you won’t be able to level up any further…?”
I can tell Big Sister has already hit the Level 40 cap.
“If it were Father, he’d turn even a situation like this into a source of strength through trust.”
“Please don’t act like you understand Naofumi-sama.”
“It’s true that no one else trusts Father as much as you do. But I’m trusting him just as much right now, so I won’t be outdone.”
You’re staring at me with narrowed eyes.
“Raphtalia-chan, I know Motoyasu-chan doesn’t mean any harm, so you really should trust him a little. Maybe you two just don’t understand each other?”
“Sigh… I know that, but my emotions just can’t keep up.”
“I see. Well then, let’s have Father take care of it tonight.”

I’m a man who can make concessions, you know. If Big Sister says it’s difficult, I can’t force the issue. So, White Swan and Kou’s level and stats were boosted in no time. They’ve grown by leaps and bounds, and White Swan and Kou have now reached the point where they can be counted as combat assets.
“Well then… shall we take on the island’s boss battle? Since combat experience is key this time, should I go easy on you as much as possible?”
“That’s true… You’d probably be able to take down the boss that appears deep within this island with a single blow.”
“I could. But I don’t think we’d be able to get the information Big Sisters are looking for that way. What do you think?”
“That’s true… but I’m not sure if there’s anything else we need to find out…”

“Here’s what we’ll do. It might be best to go back to the basics of combat. How about I take the brunt of the enemy’s attacks, just like Father does, while you Big Sisters, White Swan, and Kou attack in the meantime?”

I think this is the fighting style that would work best for you, Big Sister. It’s a way for you to fight at full strength while I hold the enemy in check. Hearing my suggestion, Big Sister let out a deep sigh.
“I don’t have any objections… but that means I wouldn’t have the chance to see how the Spear Hero fights or learn how to get stronger…”
“You mean practice? If that’s the case, I think Big Sister could show you by sparring with her older sister.”
Big Sister, the harpoon user, is second to none. It’s also obvious that she’s skilled with long weapons. I’ve learned a great deal from her myself.
“Oh my—so should Motoyasu-chan and my Big Sister practice together for Raphtalia-chan’s sake?”
“That doesn’t quite feel right…”
“It’s meaningless for heroes to try to outmaneuver one another.”
Back in the first world, the foolish me used to think that way, but it’s an unnecessary element for bringing peace to the world. We discuss everything that’s necessary. That’s an important point.
“I’ll always provide information to my Father and the others, you know.”
“Sigh… I understand. It wouldn’t be right to complain here, and the Spear Hero is certainly showing an attitude of respect and admiration toward us. Let’s get started right away.”
“Pii!”
“Kue!”

It was quite striking how Kou, who really seems to like my Big Sisters, was rubbing up against them and chirping. White Swan replied by kicking the air, as if to confirm her own growing body. And so, when we faced the island’s boss, I—just like my Father—didn’t attack but took the hits, letting my Big Sisters do the fighting. I used the loot to upgrade the Big Sisters’ equipment. By the time we finished hunting, the Big Sisters had gotten quite used to it and were even coordinating their attacks. Then, on the small boat ride back…
“Spear Hero…-sama, thank you so much for teaching us so many things today.”
Oh, a word of thanks from my Big Sister. The way she’s forcing it a bit reminds me of my Father.
“It’s nothing to thank me for. We’re fellow heroes who’ll be sailing the waves together from now on!”
“…Yes, that’s right. Let’s do our best—for Naofumi-sama’s sake…”
As if she were exhausted, Big Sister simply nodded at my words.
“That was quite a spectacular battle. I had fun really letting loose, too. Let’s go home and have a drink!”
By the way, Big Sister wasn’t riding in a small boat—she was swimming in her Beastman form.
“Kwaa!”
White Swan was swimming alongside Big Sister as part of her leg strength training.
